verdict.rationale: Featurebase advertises generic 'connect with your favorite tools' integrations plus webhooks/API for custom connections, implying support for external tool sync, but no specific support/sales/chat platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom, Slack) are named or documented. missing for 10: named integration list for support/sales/chat tools, setup docs per integration, independent confirmation of working integrations.
